name: Juejuezi (绝绝子)
blurb: Fan-speak for "absolutely amazing" from 2020 talent shows; a 2021 buzzword
title: Juejuezi (绝绝子) Meme: Meaning, Origin & Trend
description: 绝绝子 means "absolutely amazing". Talent-show fans used it to cheer contestants in 2020, and it made China's top ten internet terms of 2021.
answer: 绝绝子 (juéjuézǐ) means "absolutely amazing" or "too good". It doubles 绝 (as in 绝了, "incredible") and adds a cute 子 suffix. According to China's National Language Resources Monitoring and Research Center, it took off on an online talent show, where fans used it to cheer contestants, usually dated to 2020. On 6 December 2021 the centre named it one of the top ten internet terms of 2021, while 《咬文嚼字》 deliberately left it off its 2021 list for being too much of a word game.

body: Mostly it is enthusiastic praise: a stage, a dish or an outfit is 绝绝子 when it is perfect. It can also be used sarcastically for something absurdly bad, as in "this traffic jam is 绝绝子". The 子 ending gives it a cute, fan-club tone.
It started a pattern of adding 子 to other words, such as 无语子 (speechless), which some people find playful and others find grating.

ul: "The milk tea here is 绝绝子, go try it."
Sarcasm: "Two-hour queue in the rain, 绝绝子."
Variants with 子, such as 无语子 (speechless)
Often paired with other 2021 fan slang such as yyds

body: 绝绝子 peaked in 2021 and is now seen as a slightly dated, fan-circle style of speech. People still use it, often ironically, and it remains a standard example in discussions of whether internet slang belongs in formal language.

faq.q: What is the English for 绝绝子?
Why did 咬文嚼字 reject 绝绝子?
faq.a: Its chief editor said the word's construction is too game-like and departs from typical Chinese word-formation rules.

faq.q: Is 绝绝子 positive or negative?
faq.a: Usually positive praise, but it can be used sarcastically for something absurdly bad.
